name: dream-rsi-local
description: Local marketplace for the Dream-RSI plugin (search memory that survives compaction, and the Dream-RSI exploration loop).

plugins.name: dream-rsi
plugins.description: Stops long research sessions from re-trying what was already tried: an attempt tree on disk, a compact map, a novelty check before every attempt, and the Dream-RSI loop (arXiv 2609.14858) that tunes the exploration policy by replaying past attempts.
